project.title: Metagenomic analysis of the effect of different iron forms on microbial community in MBGS for wastewater treatment
project.description: This project aims to investigate the impact of different iron forms on the performance, microbial community structure, and functional metabolic pathways of Microalgal-Bacterial Granular Sludge (MBGS) in wastewater treatment systems. The metagenomic sequencing data will reveal key functional microorganisms, iron-related metabolic genes, and nitrogen/carbon removal mechanisms under different iron conditions, providing theoretical support for the optimization and stable operation of MBGS processes.
project.center_name: Wuhan University of Science and Technology
